trace.query: SELECT doc, id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%DRX%' OR text ILIKE '%disordered rock%' ORDER BY doc, page, id LIMIT 150

SELECT doc, id, text, value, unit, role FROM measures WHERE (array_to_string(about, ' ') ILIKE '%DRX%' OR sentence ILIKE '%DRX%' OR sentence ILIKE '%disordered rock%') AND (sentence ILIKE '%reference%' OR text ILIKE '%ref%' OR unit ILIKE '%ref%') LIMIT 100
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%DRX%' OR text ILIKE '%disordered rock%' OR text ILIKE '%disordered-rock%' ORDER BY id LIMIT 150

SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE (text ILIKE '%refer%' OR text ILIKE '%citation%' OR text ILIKE '%cited%' OR text ILIKE '%literature%' OR text ILIKE '%publications%' OR text ILIKE '%papers%') AND id LIKE 'aenm%' ORDER BY id LIMIT 150

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id LIKE 'ensm-2021:p15.%' ORDER BY page, line_no LIMIT 80
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id LIKE 'aenm-2022:p10.L2%' OR id LIKE 'aenm-2022:p11.L4%' OR id IN ('aenm-2022:p2.L12','aenm-2022:p3.L27','aenm-2022:p1.L66') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id LIKE 'aenm-2022:p9.L%' AND text ~ '\[[0-9]' ORDER BY id

WITH l AS (SELECT id, text FROM lines WHERE id ~ '^aenm-2022:p(9\.L(4[5-9]|[5-9][0-9]|1[01][0-9]|12[0-2])|11\.L4[2-5])$'), m AS (SELECT id, unnest(regexp_extract_all(text, '\[[0-9,]+\]')) AS b FROM l), n AS (SELECT id, unnest(regexp_split_to_array(regexp_replace(b, '[\[\]]', '', 'g'), ',')) AS num FROM m) SELECT num, COUNT(*) AS hits, string_agg(DISTINCT id, ' ') AS where_ FROM n GROUP BY num ORDER BY CAST(num AS INTEGER)

rendered: The review papers do not state a count of DRX references anywhere. The only review that discusses DRX cathodes at length is the cobalt-free review (aenm-2022), in its section headed 5. DRX Cathodes[1], together with the captions of its DRX figures (see Fig. 9[2]). That passage cites numbered references, and counting the distinct reference numbers in it gives 12[3] distinct reference numbers in all, or 11[4] distinct reference numbers if the general citation on Li/TM ordering is left out (the citation at [27][5]). The DRX-specific citations are [34][6], [35][7], [36][8], [37][9], [38][10], [39][11], [40][12], [41][13], [34,42][14], [43][15] and [44][16]. The other reviews touch DRX only in passing: the coatings review mentions disordered rock[17] cathodes in its conclusions without any reference count.
